name: Maryland
notes: bbox is [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], matching pmtiles extract --bbox. The west, south and north edges are HoldfastConfig.Md{Min,Max}{Lat,Lon} in the app; the east edge is pulled in from -74.98 to -75.05 because the app's value reaches into the Atlantic and every extra degree of ocean is paid for in tiles. maxzoom 14 is where OSM street geometry stops adding detail; z15+ roughly doubles the file for labels the phone can render from z14 data.

geofabrik.notes: Not used for the roads basemap (Protomaps already renders the planet). It is the input the routing graph needs, and the state.txt timestamp is what check_upstream.py watches for maps-routing-us-md.
